scripts.typecheck: bun run build:ui && tsc -b packages/core packages/ledger packages/sandbox packages/engine packages/workers packages/node packages/cli packages/ui
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/ledger packages/sandbox packages/engine packages/workers packages/node packages/cli && bun test --cwd packages/ui
scripts.build:heph: bun run build:ui && bun build --compile packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/heph --external omp-legacy-pi-modules --define HEPH_BUILD="\"$(git describe --always --dirty)\""
scripts.build:heph:linux: bun run build:ui && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/linux-x64/heph --external omp-legacy-pi-modules --define HEPH_BUILD="\"$(git describe --always --dirty)\"" && bun packages/cli/scripts/fetch-natives.ts linux-x64 dist/linux-x64
